import json, sys
path = sys.argv[1]

    with open(path) as f:
        for i, line in enumerate(f):
            try:
                o = json.loads(line)
            except: continue
            role = o.get("role") or o.get("type") or ""
            # various transcript shapes
            if role not in ("user", "human"):
                # check message.role
                msg = o.get("message") or {}
                if isinstance(msg, dict) and msg.get("role") not in ("user", "human"):

                texts = []

                        texts.append(c)
                content = "\n".join(texts)
            if not content or not isinstance(content, str):
                continue

            if "agent-transcripts" in content and "continual-learning" in content.lower():
                continue

                # try extract user_query
                pass
            # extract user_query if present
            import re
            m = re.search(r"<user_query>\s*(.*?)\s*</user_query>", content, re.S)
            if m:
                content = m.group(1)
            content = content.strip()
            if len(content) < 20:
                continue
            print(content[:2500])
            print("---")
except Exception as e:
    print("ERR", e)

import * as THREE from 'three';

export interface RotatingGlobeCity {
  lat: number;
  lng: number;
  city: string;
  sublabel?: string;
  dots?: number;
}

export interface RotatingGlobeProps {
  cities?: RotatingGlobeCity[];
  idleRotation?: number;
  initialRotation?: number;
  height?: number | string;
  backgroundColor?: string;
  clickSound?: boolean;
}

export const ROTATING_GLOBE_DEFAULT_CITIES: RotatingGlobeCity[] = [
  {
    lat: 24,
    lng: -130,
    city: 'San Francisco',
    sublabel: 'est. 2025',
    dots: 11,
  },
  { lat: 36, lng: -40, city: 'NYC', sublabel: 'est. 2024', dots: 91 },
  { lat: 8, lng: -25, city: 'Buenos Aires', sublabel: 'est. 2025', dots: 8 },
  { lat: 40, lng: 50, city: 'London', sublabel: 'est. 2025', dots: 14 },
];

function latLngToVec3(lat: number, lng: number, radius: number): THREE.Vector3 {
  const phi = ((lng + 180) * Math.PI) / 180;
  const theta = Math.min(((90 - lat) * Math.PI) / 180, Math.PI / 2);
  const x = -radius * Math.sin(theta) * Math.cos(phi);
  const y = radius * Math.cos(theta);
  const z = radius * Math.sin(theta) * Math.sin(phi);
  return new THREE.Vector3(x, y, z);
}

function hash01(s: string): number {
  let t = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++) t = Math.imul(31, t) + s.charCodeAt(i);
  const r = 10000 * Math.sin(t);
  return r - Math.floor(r);
}

python3 << 'PY'
import json, re, os
from pathlib import Path

root = Path("/Users/liamellis/.cursor/projects/Users-liamellis-Desktop-apps-ultraterrestrial-resurrection/agent-transcripts")
files = sorted(root.rglob("*.jsonl"), key=lambda p: p.stat().st_mtime, reverse=True)

# skip current memory-updater subagent
skip = {"b474f955-ad36-43c2-9ef2-187595c4a5c6.jsonl"}

def extract_user_queries(path):
    out = []
    with open(path) as f:
        for line in f:
            try:
                o = json.loads(line)
            except Exception:
                continue
            msg = o.get("message") if isinstance(o.get("message"), dict) else o
            role = (msg or {}).get("role") or o.get("role")
            if role not in ("user", "human"):
                continue
            content = (msg or {}).get("content") or o.get("content") or ""
            if isinstance(content, list):
                texts = []
                for c in content:
                    if isinstance(c, dict):
                        t = c.get("text") or c.get("content") or ""
                        if isinstance(t, str):
                            texts.append(t)
                    elif isinstance(c, str):
                        texts.append(c)
                content = "\n".join(texts)
            if not isinstance(content, str):
                continue
            m = re.search(r"<user_query>\s*(.*?)\s*</user_query>", content, re.S)
            if m:
                content = m.group(1).strip()
            else:
                # skip system-ish
                if content.strip().startswith("<") and "user_query" not in content[:300]:
                    continue
                content = content.strip()
            if len(content) < 30:
                continue
            if "continual-learning" in content.lower() and "agents-memory-updater" in content.lower():
                continue
            if content.startswith("Briefly inform the user"):
                continue
            if content.startswith("<mcp_"):
                continue
            out.append(content[:1800])
    return out

# collect preference-like signals from all parent transcripts
keywords = re.compile(
    r"(prefer|don't|do not|never|always|instead|should|hate|like|want|must|avoid|stop|rather|overkill|prune|migrate only|bake|not a|no cards|pseudocode|PSUEDOCODE|worklog|stash|solid|document your)",
    re.I,
)

seen = set()
for path in files:
    if path.name in skip:
        continue
    # prefer parent transcripts
    is_sub = "subagents" in str(path)
    qs = extract_user_queries(path)
    for q in qs:
        if not keywords.search(q):
            continue
        # skip huge code dumps
        if q.count("\n") > 40 and ("import " in q[:200] or "export " in q[:200] or "function " in q[:200]):
            continue
        key = q[:120]
        if key in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(key)
        tag = "SUB" if is_sub else "PAR"
        print(f"\n### [{tag}] {path.parent.name}/{path.name}")
        print(q[:1200])
        print("---")
print(f"\nTOTAL MATCHES: {len(seen)}")

import json
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone

root = Path("/Users/liamellis/.cursor/projects/Users-liamellis-Desktop-apps-ultraterrestrial-resurrection/agent-transcripts")
index_path = Path("/Users/liamellis/Desktop/apps/ultraterrestrial-resurrection/.cursor/hooks/state/continual-learning-index.json")

transcripts = {}
for path in sorted(root.rglob("*.jsonl")):
    rel = str(path)

    transcripts[rel] = {
        "mtimeMs": int(st.st_mtime * 1000),
        "mtimeSec": int(st.st_mtime),
        "size": st.st_size,
    }

payload = {
    "version": 1,
    "updatedAt": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    "transcripts": transcripts,
}

index_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
index_path.write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=2) + "\n")
print(f"Indexed {len(transcripts)} transcripts -> {index_path}")
